titles.native: 海馬成長痛 × Mass Destruction -Reload- マッシュアップ

description: Music video directed by Monya for a mashup featuring songs "Kaiba Seichoutsuu" by ZUTOMAYO and "Mass Destruction -Reload-" by Lotus Juice. The music video is an official collab tie-up with the band Zutto Mayonaka de Iinoni and video game Persona 3 Reload.
